newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS ups Burlington Resources.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS ups Burlington Resources.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it boosted its rating on Burlington Resources Inc to buy from hold.
-- Analyst Michael Barbis also raised his estimates for Burlington's earnings and cash flow in 1997, his office said.
-- The UBS analyst boosted his earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 $2.30 from $1.60 per share previously and for cash flow to $5.90 per share from $5.25 previously, his office said.
-- His target price for the stock is $64 over the next 12 months. The stock was up 1/4 point to 52-7/8 in early trading Tuesday.
